[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
John was born in 1832. He was the son of [[Glasgow-193|James Glasgow]] and [[McNeil-3468|Mary McNeil]]. He passed away in 1879.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-193]] is assessed at 93% (proved). Faris p 84 places John Nelson in James and Mary McNeil's family with a specific 1832 birth. His Iowa cemetery and draft citations fit the family's later Iowa setting and give no competing father.

Selected Glasgow-193 fatherhood of Glasgow-2184; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Compare Faris with James's probate and John's death record.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-2184 Faris, David, The Glasgow Family of Adams County, Ohio (Baltimore, MD, Gateway Press, Inc., 1990), p. 84]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
